<!--

  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the

Uses the `conn_made` callback of the pymysensors library to detect when a gateway connection has been made.
The old behaviour of listening for a I_GATEWAY_READY message was removed.

Looks like it does connect but homeassistant fails to recognize that it is connected. I suspect we don't receive a gateway ready message.
In my case gateway send ready message only on start, if HA don't reset gateway it don't receive that message.
Normally the gateway should reset on connect.

Well not all gateways do. I recently ran a gateway on a nrf51-based calliope mini board and the serial connection of that one does not trigger a reset. Maybe something similar is happening here?

MYSController is showing the gateway regularly sending a message with its version number. Maybe we can use that as a secondary indication that we are connected?

I think we can use the connection status callbacks:
https://github.com/theolind/pymysensors#connection-callbacks
I have diy gateway (arduino pro mini) with usb->uart adapter which hasn't DTR signal pin for reset arduino. I think the simplest option is to add a force connection flag to config.

I am on mysensors version 1.5, and my sensors were working fine with HA 2021.2.3. After upgrade HA to 2021.3.0 the sensors are not available. When I tried to install the integration (with the same basic parameters of yaml) it says that it cannot connect to the serial gateway. I am using a Rpi 3+. I revert to HA 2021.2.3 and all is working again!
